source: U.S. Drought Monitor, National Drought Mitigation Center / USDA / NOAA
format: Traditional cumulative percent of area; D1 includes D2-D4
monthly_method: Unweighted mean of weekly map values whose MapDate falls in the calendar month. Not a daily or fire-weighted mean.
join: One row per state and month. Left join from fire months; pre-2000 drought remains missing.
